questions.q: Which country was the first to make Christianity its state religion, in 301?
questions.why: Gregory the Illuminator converted King Tiridates III.

questions.q: In which year did Armenia regain independence?
questions.why: Independence Day is 21 September.

questions.q: Which genocide of 1915 is remembered on 24 April?
questions.why: About 1.5 million Armenians died.

questions.q: Which mountain, now in Turkey, is a national symbol of Armenia?
questions.why: It appears on the coat of arms.

questions.q: Who created the Armenian alphabet around 405?
questions.why: It still has 36 original letters.

questions.q: Which ancient king built an empire stretching to the Mediterranean?
questions.why: He ruled in the first century BC.

questions.q: Which devastating earthquake struck northern Armenia in 1988?
questions.why: Around 25,000 people died.

questions.q: Which 2018 peaceful protests changed the government?
questions.why: Nikol Pashinyan became Prime Minister.

questions.q: Which ancient kingdom of Urartu built Erebuni, today's Yerevan?
questions.why: Erebuni was founded in 782 BC.

questions.q: Which 451 battle is a symbol of Armenian faith?
questions.why: Vardan Mamikonian led the Armenians.

questions.q: Which 1918 battle saved Armenia from Ottoman invasion?
questions.why: It allowed the first republic to be founded.

questions.q: Which 'father of Armenian history' wrote a chronicle of the nation?
questions.why: He lived around the 400s.

questions.q: Which Armenian kingdom in Cilicia lasted until 1375?
questions.why: It was on the Mediterranean coast.

questions.q: Which monk wrote 'The Book of Lamentations', a famous prayer-poem?
questions.why: He lived in the 900s.

questions.q: Which composer of the 'Sabre Dance' was Armenian?
questions.why: It is from the ballet 'Gayane'.

questions.q: What is the capital of Armenia?
questions.why: It is one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities.

questions.q: What is Armenia's currency?
questions.why: It was introduced in 1993.

questions.q: Which large lake is in the mountains of Armenia?
questions.why: It is one of the world's largest high-altitude lakes.

questions.q: Which thin flatbread is on UNESCO's list as Armenian heritage?
questions.why: It is baked in a clay oven called a tonir.

questions.q: Which brandy is Armenia famous for?
questions.why: Winston Churchill was said to enjoy it.

questions.q: Which fruit's Latin name, Prunus armeniaca, links it to Armenia?
questions.why: Its Latin name is Prunus armeniaca.

questions.q: Which country lies west of Armenia?
questions.why: The border has been closed since 1993.

questions.q: Which cathedral is the world's oldest, built in the 300s?
questions.why: It is the seat of the Armenian Church.

questions.q: Which monastery is partly carved into a cliff?
questions.why: It is a UNESCO site.

questions.q: Which cable car to Tatev Monastery is one of the world's longest?
questions.why: It is about 5.7 km long.

questions.q: Which double-reed woodwind instrument has a haunting sound?
questions.why: Its music is on UNESCO's list.

questions.q: Which pagan temple with columns survived in Armenia?
questions.why: It was built in the first century.

questions.q: Which Armenian-American singer leads System of a Down?
questions.why: The band formed in Los Angeles.

questions.q: Which chess champion from Baku was of Armenian descent?
questions.why: His mother was Armenian.

questions.q: Which large stone cross carvings are an Armenian art form?
questions.why: Thousands survive across the country.
